query: The target architecture will integrate the government datacenter with public cloud services.
Agencies will use services from two cloud providers under a common multicloud governance framework.
Dedicated cloud connections will link government facilities to public cloud regions.
Identity, access policies, logging and monitoring will be unified across cloud and on-premises systems.
Container orchestration and open interfaces will support workload portability across environments.
A hybrid cloud will combine the government's own infrastructure with public cloud services from more than one provider.
